Name: T3 Deck
Description: Watch and steer T3 Code threads from Stream Deck: thread status, stop, prompts, model options and answers, across every provider.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.activity.Name: Activity
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.activity.Tooltip: The most urgent thread matching a filter. Tap opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.new.Name: New Thread
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.new.Tooltip: Starts a new thread in the selected thread's project, no project, or a chosen one; with a saved prompt or empty.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.send.Name: Send Prompt
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.send.Tooltip: Sends a saved prompt to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.steer.Name: Steer
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.steer.Tooltip: Adds a saved instruction to the selected thread's running turn.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.quick.Name: Quick Prompt
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.quick.Tooltip: Sends an everyday prompt to the selected thread: continue, fix tests, diagnose, explain, commit, or your own.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.stop.Name: Stop
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.stop.Tooltip: Stops the running turn of the thread selected in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.model.Name: Model
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.model.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread to a favorite model, or to the next of T3 Code's favorites.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.effort.Name: Effort
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.effort.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's reasoning effort, or steps through what its model offers.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.speed.Name: Speed
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.speed.Tooltip: Toggles fast mode on the selected thread where its model offers it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.permissions.Name: Permissions
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.permissions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's access, from Supervised to Full access, or steps through them.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.plan.Name: Plan
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.plan.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread between Build and Plan.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.approve.Name: Approve
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.approve.Tooltip: Answers the selected thread's approval as far as its settings allow, or opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.slot.Name: Thread
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.slot.Tooltip: One thread from the board, filled by key position: status, title and timer. Tap opens it in T3 Code; hold selects it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.organize.Name: Organize
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.organize.Tooltip: Settles, pins, snoozes, archives or marks the selected thread unread.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.pr.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state. Tap opens it.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.branch.Name: Branch
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.branch.Tooltip: The selected thread's branch. Tap opens the thread in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.health.Name: Health
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.health.Tooltip: The connection to T3 Code: ready, connecting, needs pairing or failing. Tap reconnects.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.threads.Name: Threads Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.threads.Tooltip: Rotate through the threads that match its filter, selecting them in T3 Code; press or tap to open one.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.model.Name: Power Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.model.Tooltip: Changes the selected thread's model, effort or access; press or tap switches Speed where offered.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.prompts.Name: Prompts Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.prompts.Tooltip: Rotate through your prompts and templates. Press sends to the selected thread; hold starts a new thread.

com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.answer.Name: Answer Dial
com.alejandrom2.t3deck.dial.answer.Tooltip: Answers an agent's question choice by choice, and approvals as far as its settings allow.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.appLinkHint: Use t3code-dev to open threads in a development build.
advanced.stateLineLabel: Show the colored line under each strip
advanced.stateHint: Thread state tints a strip green when done, red when failed and amber when it needs you. Each dial can override this in its own settings.
advanced.styleHint: List turns through a dial's items like a wheel, Carousel shows each as a tile between its neighbors. Long text moves once the dial rests, twice, then stops; touch and hold the strip to read it all, and turn to scroll.

filter.attention: Needs you: approval, question, failure or unread result

slot.label: Slot
slot.hint: By key position fills Thread keys left to right, top to bottom. Threads are ordered: needs approval, has a question, running, then the rest. Tap opens, hold selects.

activity.hint: Shows the most urgent matching thread. More Activity keys with the same settings show the next ones, by key position.

answer.hint: Turn between this choice and Deny. A request that doesn't offer the choice opens in T3 Code instead. Touch and hold the strip to read a long request in full.

send.promptPlaceholder: Run the tests and fix what fails
send.hint: Goes to the thread selected in T3 Code: it starts a turn, or steers or queues behind a running one. Hold the key to interrupt and restart with it.

steer.promptPlaceholder: Keep the change small and skip the refactor
steer.hint: Adds to the selected thread's running turn. It's dimmed while the thread is idle.

quick.customPlaceholder: Type the prompt this key sends
quick.hint: Goes to the thread selected in T3 Code. Hold the key to interrupt and restart with it.

new.promptPlaceholder: Optional: Review the open pull request
new.title: Thread title
new.hint: With a prompt, the thread starts working and the deck selects it. Without one, it opens empty in T3 Code. With no thread selected, it starts with no project. It uses T3 Code's default model and access.

model.hint: Cycling steps through T3 Code's favorite models, across providers, or the thread's provider's models when you have none. Picking another provider's model hands the thread over, as T3 Code's model picker does.

effort.hint: Cycling steps through the efforts the selected thread's model offers. A set effort its model doesn't offer dims the key. Ultrathink doesn't change the effort: like T3 Code, it prefixes the prompts the deck sends to that thread until you pick another effort.

permissions.hint: Applies to the selected thread from its next step. Only the modes its provider supports are offered.

approve.hint: Answers the selected thread's approval. A request that doesn't offer this choice, or that the deck can't answer, opens in T3 Code. Deny is its own key.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.templatesLabel: Add Continue, Fix tests, Diagnose, Explain and Commit
prompts.hint: Rotate to choose, press to send to the selected thread, hold to start a new thread.

threads.hint: Rotate through the matching threads, most urgent first; the one the dial rests on becomes T3 Code's selection. Press or tap opens it.

power.hint: Rotate to preview, press to apply to the selected thread. Model turns through T3 Code's favorite models across providers. Press with nothing to apply, or tap, to switch Speed when the model offers it. Ultrathink, where Claude offers it, prefixes the deck's next prompts to the thread.
